findings.claim: The `!NETFRAMEWORK` guard suppresses ExcludeFromCodeCoverage for every .NET Framework build, even though supported .NET Framework 4.x targets provide System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute. Generated resolvers and formatters therefore remain uncovered by the requested attribute on those targets; the conditional is broader than necessary to keep compilation working.

receipt_plan.detail: Run Receipts.GeneratedTests.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageFrameworkTests.Resolver_HasActiveAttribute_WhenNetFrameworkSymbolIsDefined. It runs the generator with the NETFRAMEWORK preprocessor symbol and requires an active ExcludeFromCodeCoverage attribute in a generated syntax tree; on head the attribute is disabled text and the test fails. The same guard in the other changed templates should receive the same correction.
